lines.text: Welcome, traveller! I'm Wilky. Every new face that comes down this road gets a proper hello from me.
This is Learner's Hollow. A quiet little valley where people come to get better at things.
Every corner of the Hollow teaches something different. Most folks start with whatever is closest to the gate.
Plenty to explore. What else can I help you with?
Learn something, then try it out. That's the whole secret of this place.
Each challenge you finish opens the way to the next. And don't worry about getting things wrong. Mistakes are how the Hollow teaches.
Walk wherever you like. If someone looks like they have something to say, step up close and talk to them, just like you did with me.
And if you ever need a breather, you can pause at any time. The Hollow will wait for you.
Off you go, then! If you ever get lost, come find me. I'm always right here by the gate.
